threepl.simulator

Class SimInteger

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.simulator.SimValue
      • threepl.simulator.SimNumber
        • threepl.simulator.SimInteger
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable, TDEConstants, Constant, SimTypes
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    SimSigned, SimUnsigned

    public abstract class SimInteger
extends SimNumber
    A SimInteger is a SimNumber containing a non-floating point number. It can contain a signed or unsigned integer or fixed point number.
    Version:
    $Revision: 6003 $
    Author:
    Andrew Tulloh

      • isConnectable

        public boolean isConnectable(SimValue src)
        Return true is the src SimValue is connectable with this. Must be a SimInteger with same precision. Note this allows compatibility between SimSigned and SimUnsigned quantities.
        Overrides:
        isConnectable in class SimValue
        Parameters:
        src - The SimValue to test for compatibility
        Returns:
        True if src is connectable with this

        public boolean lt(SimValue src)
